lore.common: Prods everyone who reaches past it for the window latch.
lore.uncommon: Is forgotten for months without water and still looks smug.
lore.rare: Fires one spine at anyone who calls it cute. It never misses, and it never says sorry.
lore.epic: Grew so many arms that the family started hanging their coats on it. Every coat in the house now has tiny holes.
lore.legendary: Waited a hundred years to bloom, then did it the one week its owner was on holiday. The neighbour has the only photo.

lore.common: Gets the wrong things put in it every single week.
lore.uncommon: Rattles with glass bottles all the way to the kerb.
lore.rare: Refuses to be collected if one yoghurt pot is unwashed.
lore.epic: Rattled its bottles so loudly on bin night that the bin lorry came a day early, just to make it stop.
lore.legendary: Sorted a whole town's rubbish in one night, then put the town hall in the paper bin because it was mostly forms.

lore.common: Overflows the morning after every party.
lore.uncommon: Stacks bottles so high that they clink in the wind.
lore.rare: Clinks its bottles in the exact tune of the ice cream van, so every child on the street runs out with money.
lore.epic: Tumbled down the hill in a gale, playing a tune on its bottles all the way. The brass band has asked for the music.
lore.legendary: Recycled itself into a brand-new crate, then put the old one out for collection. Even the bin lorry cannot tell which one is which.

lore.common: Makes everyone with hay fever sneeze at the exact moment they say how pretty it is.
lore.uncommon: Has a bee on it every single time you lean in to smell it.
lore.rare: Changes colour to match whoever stands next to it, so the bride vanished from every wedding photo.
lore.epic: Bloomed in the middle of the football pitch, and the referee would not let anyone tread on it. The match was played round it.
lore.legendary: Pollinated every garden in the country with one sneeze. The bees have gone on strike, saying it is doing their job.

lore.common: Always has one pole missing when you get to the campsite.
lore.uncommon: Flaps its flysheet all night so loudly that nobody sleeps.
lore.rare: Picks up its pegs in the night and moves to the comfiest spot, so its campers wake up in someone else's pitch.
lore.epic: Collapsed on the whole camping group in the middle of the night, and everyone woke up wearing it.
lore.legendary: Climbed the mountain on its own in the night, pegs and all. The climbers reached the top and found it had made tea.

lore.common: Splashes everyone standing too close to the side of the boat.
lore.uncommon: Churns the river into white foam behind it.
lore.rare: Spins backwards whenever a passenger says they are in a hurry. The ferry has never once been on time.
lore.epic: Churned so hard that it pushed the whole river back upstream. The salmon had to do their journey twice.
lore.legendary: Paddled a river steamer across the open sea without noticing it had left the river. The captain says it was a shortcut.

lore.common: Gets flour in its pocket that puffs out every time you reach in.
lore.uncommon: Has strings that tie themselves into a knot behind your back.
lore.rare: Throws every splash it catches straight back at the cook. The chef now wears swimming goggles to make soup.
lore.epic: Shook out its pocket at the bake sale, and the hall disappeared under flour. The caretaker had to use a snow shovel.
lore.legendary: Cooked a whole wedding feast by itself while its owner had a nap. It still got the blame for the one burnt sausage.

lore.common: Has a big bow at the back that unties itself whenever its wearer is carrying something hot.
lore.uncommon: Blends into the flowery kitchen wallpaper so well that nobody can find the cook at dinner time.
lore.rare: Ties its own strings to anything nearby, so its wearer keeps getting attached to the fence.
lore.epic: Spun round once at the barn dance, and every bow in the hall untied itself. The band had to stop and help.
lore.legendary: Picked every strawberry in the county into its front pocket in one morning. The jam factory now delivers straight to it.

lore.common: Is so bulky that its wearer can't put their arms down.
lore.uncommon: Has a little whistle attached that everyone blows on the first day.
lore.rare: Is so buoyant that it floats on dry land, and its wearer has to be tied to the bench like a balloon.
lore.epic: Inflated so fast on the lake that it lifted the canoe instructor clean out of the water. He has asked for a slower one.
lore.legendary: Floated its sleeping wearer across the sea and back in one night. He woke on the same beach, very confused by his tan.

lore.common: Is raided by the squirrel within an hour of being filled.
lore.uncommon: Spills seeds all over the lawn, which grow into weeds.
lore.rare: Lets in only birds with good manners. The pigeons now queue in a polite line, and the squirrel has been barred.
lore.epic: Fed so many birds one morning that the flock lifted the garden shed and dropped it in the park.
lore.legendary: Taught a robin to ring the doorbell when the seed runs out. Now every bird in the street rings it at six in the morning.

lore.common: Sits empty all spring while the birds nest in the hedge instead.
lore.uncommon: Measures every bird at the door, and turns away anyone a single feather too wide.
lore.rare: Chirps so convincingly that the cat sits underneath it for hours. There has never been a bird inside.
lore.epic: Was moved into by so many birds that it grew a second floor overnight. The blue tits complain about the noise upstairs.
lore.legendary: Built itself an extension so big that two owls, a heron and the postman now live in it. The postman has never been happier.

lore.common: Snaps shut on the postman's fingers every single morning.
lore.uncommon: Whistles a cold draught down the hall all winter, always during the quietest part of the film.
lore.rare: Swallows the post and spits it onto the mat face down.
lore.epic: Snapped shut on the postman's sleeve and would not let go until he read out every letter. The street now knows far too much.
lore.legendary: Ate a whole sack of junk mail in one bite, then posted it back to the senders. Not one flyer has arrived in town since.

lore.common: Pops up overnight in the middle of the lawn, where it wasn't yesterday.
lore.uncommon: Grows in a perfect circle that people call a fairy ring.
lore.rare: Changes colour when touched, so everyone learns to look and not pick.
lore.epic: Sprouted all over the football pitch after the rain, and the match was moved to the car park.
lore.legendary: Grew a fairy ring so wide that it went round the whole town. Everyone inside it keeps losing exactly one sock.

lore.common: Overflows every time the plant is watered.
lore.uncommon: Hides a puddle under the pot that nobody notices for weeks.
lore.rare: Becomes a hotel for every slug in the garden.
lore.epic: Overflowed under every plant on the windowsill, and the carpet got a big wet stripe.
lore.legendary: Caught every drip from a leaking roof all winter, then poured it back on the plant in one go. The plant has moved out.

lore.common: Grows more weeds than flowers.
lore.uncommon: Is so heavy when full of soil that nobody can move it.
lore.rare: Grows whatever the neighbours planted instead, so the family keeps picking next door's courgettes.
lore.epic: Grew a tomato so heavy that the patio tipped over, and the barbecue slid into the pond.
lore.legendary: Grew a pumpkin so big in one window box that the wall came down to get it in. The family now live in a three-bed pumpkin.

lore.common: Pricks your finger with a thorn every time you try to smell it.
lore.uncommon: Drops its petals all over the table the day after you pick it.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who sniffs it fall in love with the nearest object. The gardener now writes poems to his wheelbarrow.
lore.epic: Grew over the front door so thickly in one night that the family used the cat flap for a week.
lore.legendary: Grew a hedge so thick round a castle that everyone inside dozed off for a week. The postman is still waiting at the gate.

lore.common: Clatters down the ice track so loudly that the spectators cover their ears.
lore.uncommon: Takes the bends so tightly that its crew nearly touch the walls.
lore.rare: Goes so fast that it finishes the run before its crew have finished climbing in.
lore.epic: Raced down the ice track in record time, and the crowd's hats blew off.
lore.legendary: Slid so fast that it went round the track and back up the mountain. The ski lift has been made redundant.

lore.common: Gets pulled by dogs who bark the whole way.
lore.uncommon: Sprays snow up behind it like a little white storm.
lore.rare: Steers itself towards the nearest sausage shop, whichever way its driver shouts.
lore.epic: Was pulled so hard that it skimmed across the frozen lake, the river and a car park. The dogs only stopped for a squirrel.
lore.legendary: Pulled its team all the way to the North Pole, then turned straight round because one dog had forgotten its ball.

lore.common: Zooms off before its rider has finished standing on it.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of battery just at the bottom of the biggest hill.
lore.rare: Hears the word 'go' in any sentence and leaves. Nobody in the house can say 'good morning' any more.
lore.epic: Ran out of battery on the high street, so it plugged itself into the town clock. The whole town is now ten minutes slow.
lore.legendary: Charged itself from a thunderstorm and rode to the seaside and back before breakfast. Its owner found sand in the wheels.

lore.common: Wobbles under its rider until they wave their arms like a windmill.
lore.uncommon: Spins round in circles when its rider leans the wrong way.
lore.rare: Carries its rider sideways into the kitchen when they only meant to go forwards.
lore.epic: Spun round the whole living room and knocked over every lamp.
lore.legendary: Hovered so high one morning that its rider ate breakfast on the roof. The pigeons now expect toast every day.

lore.common: Jumps every wave so hard that its rider lands with a bump.
lore.uncommon: Sprays a tail of water over the one person on the beach who had managed to stay dry.
lore.rare: Drives on anything wet, so it keeps turning up in the car wash and the paddling pool.
lore.epic: Jumped a wave so high that it landed on the pier and joined the ice cream queue as if nothing had happened.
lore.legendary: Raced a pod of dolphins right across the ocean and lost. The dolphins have asked for a rematch on land.

lore.common: Crosses over the other ski and sends its skier face first into the snow.
lore.uncommon: Falls off the ski lift and has to be fetched from the bottom.
lore.rare: Skis uphill whenever its skier wants to go down. The instructor calls it character building.
lore.epic: Skied straight through the mountain cafe and out of the other side, taking a plate of chips with it.
lore.legendary: Won the slalom race by a whisker after crossing the finish line backwards.

lore.common: Bumps into every tree on the way down the hill.
lore.uncommon: Is pulled up the hill by its rope, which always feels heavier than going down.
lore.rare: Slides on anything, not just snow. It has been down the stairs, the drive and, once, the school roof.
lore.epic: Slid down the hill, across the village green and in through the bakery door. It came out with a bun stuck on its front.
lore.legendary: Hit the bump at the bottom so hard that it flew over the town and landed on the next hill. It wants to go again.

lore.common: Takes ten minutes to strap into, then falls over straight away.
lore.uncommon: Spends more time on its rider's bottom than on the snow.
lore.rare: Flies up the half-pipe so high that its rider waves to the ski lift.
lore.epic: Jumped so high out of the half-pipe that it landed on the cafe roof and slid in through the chimney.
lore.legendary: Spun so many times in one jump that it did not come down until the next morning. Its rider had breakfast in the air.

lore.common: Wipes out its rider on every second wave.
lore.uncommon: Is covered in wax that sticks to everyone's feet.
lore.rare: Hears a wave coming from miles away, so it drags its surfer out of bed at four in the morning.
lore.epic: Caught a wave so big that it surfed through the seafront hotel and out of the back door into the car park.
lore.legendary: Rode one wave all the way round the world and arrived back on the same beach. Its surfer was very late for tea.

lore.common: Slowly leaks overnight so you wake up on the floor.
lore.uncommon: Takes an hour of pumping before it's even half full.
lore.rare: Squeaks every time its sleeper rolls over, so the whole tent thinks there is a duck inside.
lore.epic: Was pumped up so hard that it lifted the tent off the ground, and the campers woke up floating over the next field.
lore.legendary: Floated a sleeping holidaymaker all the way to a tiny island. He liked it so much that he opened a cafe there.

lore.common: Fights back every time you try to roll it up.
lore.uncommon: Is so thin that you feel every pebble under your back.
lore.rare: Finds the one stone under the tent and puts it right under your hip.
lore.epic: Sprang open so hard in the scout hut that it rolled the scout leader up inside it. He slept surprisingly well.
lore.legendary: Rolled itself up so tightly one morning that it fitted in a pencil case. It has refused to unroll ever since.

lore.common: Slips across the tent floor all night so you end up by the door.
lore.uncommon: Crinkles every time you turn over.
lore.rare: Reflects the campfire so well that it toasts its sleeper's back like a crumpet.
lore.epic: Blew away in the night with its camper still asleep on it. He woke up on the village green, next to the duck pond.
lore.legendary: Kept its sleeper so comfy on a mountain that he slept through the whole winter like a bear.

lore.common: Droops its heavy head so low that it looks sad.
lore.uncommon: Turns to face the sun all day, so every photo is from behind.
lore.rare: Turns to stare at anyone eating sunflower seeds. Nobody in the garden can finish a snack.
lore.epic: Turned to follow the sun so fast that it spun the scarecrow round and round all afternoon.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall that it blocked the sunset for the whole valley. Evenings there now start at lunchtime.

lore.common: Creaks its lid open and lets out a smell that clears the garden.
lore.uncommon: Is home to a thousand wriggling worms.
lore.rare: Turns banana skins into soil so fast that the gardener suspects magic.
lore.epic: Rotted so fast one summer that the lid floated off on the smell, and the neighbours bought clothes pegs for their noses.
lore.legendary: Turned a whole year of the town's peelings into one hill. The council put a bench on top and called it a view.

lore.common: Flips its lid up so fast that it bangs the cupboard above.
lore.uncommon: Misses its pedal every time you step on it in a hurry.
lore.rare: Knows when you are about to throw away something useful, and keeps its lid shut until you change your mind.
lore.epic: Overflowed after the birthday party until the lid stood straight up like a hat.
lore.legendary: Opened its lid so fast that it fired a banana skin over the roof. It landed in a bin two streets away.

lore.common: Sits quietly in the corner of every washroom stall.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid that closes softly so nobody notices it.
lore.rare: Keeps the washroom tidy without anyone ever thanking it.
lore.epic: Kept its corner so tidy that the cleaners gave it a name badge and asked it to train the new mop.
lore.legendary: Was so discreet that the whole shopping centre forgot it existed, until it politely asked for a holiday.

lore.common: Has a bright yellow lid so that nobody mistakes it for anything else.
lore.uncommon: Clicks shut and locks so it can never be opened again.
lore.rare: Keeps the clinic safe by swallowing every used needle.
lore.epic: Shut its lid so loudly at the flu clinic that everyone forgot to be nervous about their jab.
lore.legendary: Is so bright yellow that the air ambulance uses it to find the hospital roof. Nobody is allowed to move it.

lore.common: Is missed by every paper ball thrown at it.
lore.uncommon: Collects every crumpled idea from the day.
lore.rare: Uncrumples every paper ball overnight, so the office arrives to find all its bad ideas flat on the desks.
lore.epic: Swallowed the boss's important letter with a burp, and the whole office spent the afternoon reading rubbish.
lore.legendary: Caught a paper ball thrown from the other side of the river. A basketball team has asked it to stand under their hoop.

lore.common: Wobbles on the kerb every bin day and tips over in the wind.
lore.uncommon: Flaps its lid in the breeze like it's trying to talk.
lore.rare: Wheels itself to the kerb on bin day but never comes back. It is found streets away, chatting to other bins.
lore.epic: Was blown over in a gale and carried down the street like a runaway sledge, lid flapping.
lore.legendary: Rolled itself onto the bin lorry, drove it round the town and did the whole collection. The crew had a lie-in.

lore.common: Closes its petals at night as if it's going to sleep.
lore.uncommon: Droops its stem in the vase after one day.
lore.rare: Changes colour each spring, so the gardener has to guess what it will be this time.
lore.epic: Shut every tulip in the park at lunchtime, and the bees had to queue outside like customers at a closed shop.
lore.legendary: Grew a bulb so precious that the town swapped it for a brand-new bridge. The bridge is lovely, but it keeps flowering.

lore.common: Sprays the path more than the lawn.
lore.uncommon: Ticks round in a circle so slowly that you can run through the gap.
lore.rare: Switches itself on the moment someone sits in a deckchair, then pretends to be broken.
lore.epic: Was left on all night by mistake, and the whole garden turned into a swamp full of happy frogs.
lore.legendary: Spun so fast on the hottest day that it lifted off and watered the next village too. They sent it a postcard.

lore.common: Pops up out of the lawn when you're sitting on it.
lore.uncommon: Gets run over by the lawnmower every summer.
lore.rare: Twists its spray in a direction nobody expected.
lore.epic: Popped up across the whole park during the picnic, and everyone grabbed their sandwiches.
lore.legendary: Popped up in the middle of the cricket final and soaked the bowler mid-run. The umpire gave the batter six runs for it.

lore.common: Is used as a whistle by blowing across it, which makes a shriek.
lore.uncommon: Is the perfect size for a fairy's hat, according to every child.
lore.rare: Fits on any fingertip and will not come off, so its finder spends the afternoon waving like a puppet.
lore.epic: Was blown across the park in one gust and landed on every pigeon's head. The pigeons refuse to take them off.
lore.legendary: Whistled so loudly through one child's thumbs that every dog in the county came running and sat down to wait for orders.

lore.common: Grows without any soil, which confuses everyone.
lore.uncommon: Needs dunking in water once a week like a little bath.
lore.rare: Floats off its shelf when nobody is looking and hangs from the ceiling, looking innocent.
lore.epic: Drifted out of the window and floated round the town for a week, having a quick bath in every fountain.
lore.legendary: Breathed in so hard that it soaked up a whole fog bank and left the harbour sparkling. The lighthouse has nothing to do.

lore.common: Oozes gooey gel from every leaf you snap.
lore.uncommon: Is rubbed on sunburn by every grandma.
lore.rare: Cools anything it touches, so the tea goes cold and the toast goes floppy.
lore.epic: Oozed so much gel in the heatwave that the patio became a slide. The cat has been going round on it since Tuesday.
lore.legendary: Soothed a sunburn on the Sun itself. The Sun now wears a little hat every summer.

lore.common: Grows so fast that it pokes up through the patio.
lore.uncommon: Has a hollow stem that whistles in the wind.
lore.rare: Is so tasty to pandas that the zoo keeps it behind glass, and the pandas press their noses on it all day.
lore.epic: Took over the whole garden in one summer, and the neighbours found it in their shed.
lore.legendary: Bent right down in a typhoon and flicked a fishing boat back into the harbour like a pea.

lore.common: Drops a leaf every time it's moved.
lore.uncommon: Has waxy flowers that look almost like plastic.
lore.rare: Grows leaves shaped like elephant ears and uses them to listen in on every phone call in the house.
lore.epic: Bloomed so pink that the flamingos at the zoo escaped to stand next to its window box.
lore.legendary: Bloomed so hard all year that it forgot to stop for winter, and the snow had to fall round it.

lore.common: Is so small that visitors think it's a toy.
lore.uncommon: Gets snipped so carefully that it takes an hour for one branch.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who looks at it whisper, so the house goes silent whenever it is in the room.
lore.epic: Grew a tiny forest on its pot, with a tiny storm that soaked the windowsill and blew the curtains about.
lore.legendary: Shrank a whole mountain to fit in its pot, snowy top and all. Climbers now climb it on the windowsill in an afternoon.

lore.common: Gets stuck to the inside of your pocket.
lore.uncommon: Has red and white stripes that swirl round and round.
lore.rare: Hooks itself onto anything that walks past, and was last seen riding round on the cat's collar.
lore.epic: Hooked a passing kite at the winter fair and flew the whole sweet stall into the next field.
lore.legendary: Hooked the Moon on a cold night and pulled it down for a lick. The Moon still has a minty stripe.

lore.common: Taps on the pavement so loudly that pigeons fly off.
lore.uncommon: Has a curved handle that hooks onto every table edge.
lore.rare: Hooks anything its owner points at, from a dropped glove to a pigeon's dinner.
lore.epic: Tapped such a catchy rhythm on the pavement that the whole bus queue started tap dancing.
lore.legendary: Hooked a runaway bus by its back bumper and held it until the driver came back. Its owner never even put down his paper.

lore.common: Takes off like a kite in the first gust of wind.
lore.uncommon: Pinches fingers in its folding legs every time it's put up.
lore.rare: Collects a pool of rain on its roof that drops on whoever touches it.
lore.epic: Folded up so suddenly at the market that it packed away the cake stall, the cakes and the cake seller.
lore.legendary: Stayed up so long at the summer fair that the post office gave it its own postcode.

lore.common: Has frilly petals that look like they've been cut with scissors.
lore.uncommon: Is pinned on every jacket at every wedding.
lore.rare: Lasts so long in a vase that people forget it's real.
lore.epic: Was dyed blue for a wedding and drank so much dye that the vase, the table and the best man all turned blue.
lore.legendary: Smelled so strongly of cloves that the whole wedding sneezed through the vows. The couple got married twice to be safe.

lore.common: Drops petals on every car parked underneath.
lore.uncommon: Blooms for only a few days, so everyone rushes to see it.
lore.rare: Bursts into bloom whenever a camera points at it, then drops every petal the moment the camera goes away.
lore.epic: Blossomed so thickly over the bus stop that the bus drove straight past it. Half the town was late for work.
lore.legendary: Bloomed so beautifully that the whole city took the day off to look. The office computers are still waiting.

lore.common: Only blooms when everything else in the garden has finished.
lore.uncommon: Has so many petals that it looks like a pompom.
lore.rare: Fires out a pompom of petals whenever it is startled, so the cat walks round it on tiptoe.
lore.epic: Grew a pompom so huge that the school borrowed it as a football for a whole term.
lore.legendary: Opened a thousand petals at once and blew the roof off the greenhouse like a party popper.

lore.common: Has only three leaves every time someone looks for a fourth.
lore.uncommon: Covers the lawn so thickly that the bees come buzzing.
lore.rare: Gives a little luck to whoever finds it, but only little: everyone who picks it finds a coin and loses a sock.
lore.epic: Spread across the bowling green in one night, and every bowl now rolls in curly lines.
lore.legendary: Grew one clover with a hundred leaves. It is so lucky that it keeps winning raffles it never entered.

lore.common: Sends its bails flying across the pitch whenever the ball touches them.
lore.uncommon: Leans slightly backwards so they look tired.
lore.rare: Steps a tiny bit to the left whenever the ball is coming, so nobody in the village can get bowled out.
lore.epic: Was hit so hard that its bails flew over the pavilion and into the umpire's sandwich. Play stopped for an argument.
lore.legendary: Stood unbeaten for a whole summer while the bowlers retired one by one. The last one now runs the tea shop.

lore.common: Rubs its padded top under your arm until it's sore.
lore.uncommon: Makes going up stairs a slow, careful hop.
lore.rare: Grips the ground so firmly that its user can stand still in a gale while everyone else blows down the street.
lore.epic: Swung its user so fast down the hospital corridor that the porter with the tea trolley had to leap aside.
lore.legendary: Swung its user over the river in one leap, and the bridge has felt rather useless ever since.

lore.common: Nods its trumpet head in the wind like it's agreeing with everything.
lore.uncommon: Is always the first flower to come up in spring.
lore.rare: Toots its trumpet at sunrise, so the whole street wakes up one minute before every alarm clock.
lore.epic: Came up so early that it pushed through the snowman's hat, and the snowman looked surprised all week.
lore.legendary: Bloomed so early one year that spring got the date wrong and turned up in January. Winter is still sulking.

lore.common: Gets blown by every child to tell the time, which is always wrong.
lore.uncommon: Pops up in every lawn, no matter how often it's pulled.
lore.rare: Grants a tiny wish to every child who blows it, but always the wrong one. Somebody asked for a puppy and got a puddle.
lore.epic: Blew so many seeds through the open window that the classroom had grown a lawn by home time.
lore.legendary: Blew one seed so far that it landed on top of the highest mountain and grew there. The climbers now wave at it.

lore.common: Keeps every football that goes over it.
lore.uncommon: Leans a little further each winter.
lore.rare: Grows a new panel every night, so the garden is a little smaller each morning.
lore.epic: Fell over in a storm, and two neighbours met for the first time in twenty years.
lore.legendary: Was painted so many times that it is now mostly paint, and it stands up on its own without any posts.

lore.common: Uncurls so slowly that you can watch it for a whole morning.
lore.uncommon: Grows only in the shadiest, dampest corners of the garden.
lore.rare: Unrolls its fronds across the path overnight, so the morning jogger trips over a green carpet.
lore.epic: Spread through the wood in one wet week, and the orienteering club are still finding their way out.
lore.legendary: Is so old that it still remembers the dinosaurs, and tells off the chickens for forgetting where they came from.

lore.common: Sheds a pile of leaves every time it's moved.
lore.uncommon: Hates being moved and sulks for weeks.
lore.rare: Leans towards whoever is talking about it, so the whole office has learned to whisper nice things.
lore.epic: Shed every leaf on the morning of the big meeting, and the boss gave his talk standing in a pile.
lore.legendary: Was moved to a new desk once and sulked so hard that the whole company moved back to the old building.

lore.common: Snags its hook on the angler's own hat on the very first cast.
lore.uncommon: Clicks so loudly that every fish in the lake knows it's there.
lore.rare: Reels so fast that it has pulled in fish, a duck and once a canoe with a very surprised man in it.
lore.epic: Tangled its line right round the lake, and the swans spent the afternoon untying each other.
lore.legendary: Reeled in the far bank of the lake by mistake. The lake is now much smaller, and the fish are not pleased.

lore.common: Casts its line straight into the tree behind its owner.
lore.uncommon: Catches old boots far more often than fish.
lore.rare: Catches fish that promise to tell it where the bigger ones are. The fish are very good at fibbing.
lore.epic: Cast so far that it hooked a sausage off a barbecue on the other bank. The owner still wants it back.
lore.legendary: Caught a fish so big that it pulled its owner halfway across the river before letting go.

lore.common: Sheds petals all the way from the shop to the front door.
lore.uncommon: Is too big for every vase in the house.
lore.rare: Makes whoever is holding it sneeze all over the person they were about to give it to.
lore.epic: Was tossed at the wedding and flew over every guest's head into the cake.
lore.legendary: Smelled so good that every bee in the county followed the delivery van. The driver had to deliver the bees as well.

lore.common: Snags every ball in the hole in its net.
lore.uncommon: Rings like a bell every time the ball hits the post.
lore.rare: Shuffles a little wider whenever the home team shoots, and a little narrower for the visitors.
lore.epic: Was the target of a penalty shootout that went on until it was too dark to see.
lore.legendary: Stopped every shot in a whole match, and the goalkeeper got all the credit.

lore.common: Wilts a little more every hour it hangs.
lore.uncommon: Hangs over every doorway on party days.
lore.rare: Ties itself round anyone who walks underneath, so the guest of honour arrives looking like a flowerbed.
lore.epic: Was strung across the street so low that the double-decker bus drove off wearing it.
lore.legendary: Was made so long that it joined two villages together. They now argue every week about whose turn it is to water it.

lore.common: Creaks so loudly that the whole street knows someone's coming.
lore.uncommon: Jams its latch so you have to climb over it.
lore.rare: Swings shut behind every walker but opens again for the cows. The farmer suspects a plot.
lore.epic: Was left open by a walker, and every cow on the farm went for a stroll.
lore.legendary: Swung open so hard in a storm that it let the whole countryside in. There is now a hill in the back garden.

lore.common: Sways in the breeze so the bunting flutters all day.
lore.uncommon: Holds bunting round its edge like a crown.
lore.rare: Catches every balloon that floats away from a party and keeps them in its roof like a nest.
lore.epic: Blew over two fences in a summer storm and landed over next door's barbecue, which carried on regardless.
lore.legendary: Hosted a garden party that never ended. Last summer's guests are still there, and they have built a pond.

lore.common: Smells of lemon when you brush its leaves.
lore.uncommon: Sits in every windowbox on the street.
lore.rare: Glows so red in the front window that drivers keep stopping outside, thinking it is a traffic light.
lore.epic: Grew from one cutting into so many plants that the window boxes ran out and it moved into the bath.
lore.legendary: Made the whole town take up gardening just to keep up with it. The high street now sells nothing but compost.

lore.common: Leaves green stains on the knees of every pair of trousers.
lore.uncommon: Tickles bare feet on summer mornings.
lore.rare: Grows back taller every time it's mown.
lore.epic: Grew so long over one holiday that the family lost the lawnmower in it, and found a tortoise that was not theirs.
lore.legendary: Grew back so stubbornly that the lawnmower handed in its notice.

lore.common: Opens a new flower in the morning and drops it by evening.
lore.uncommon: Has a huge trumpet flower with a long stalk sticking out.
lore.rare: Makes anyone standing near it talk about their holidays, and they cannot stop.
lore.epic: Bloomed so big at the garden party that a guest wore it as a sun hat, and nobody could find her all afternoon.
lore.legendary: Bloomed so brightly that the grey sky over town turned blue to match, and it has stayed that way all summer.

lore.common: Clacks on every rock, so the hikers sound like a herd of goats.
lore.uncommon: Probes every puddle to see how deep it is.
lore.rare: Finds the one bog on the hill and plants itself in it, so its hiker always ends up with one wet boot.
lore.epic: Pole-vaulted its hiker over the stream, the stile and one very startled sheep in a single jump.
lore.legendary: Poked the top of the mountain so hard that it grew a little taller. Every map in the country had to be reprinted.

lore.common: Gets knocked over by every runner who clips it.
lore.uncommon: Bashes the knees of every runner who doesn't jump high enough.
lore.rare: Seems to grow taller every time someone runs at it.
lore.epic: Was knocked over in every lane at sports day, and the track looked like a game of skittles.
lore.legendary: Stood back up so fast after being knocked over that it tripped the winner on the way back. The race is being rerun.

lore.common: Turns pink in one garden and blue in the next, depending on the soil.
lore.uncommon: Has flower heads so big that they look like pompoms.
lore.rare: Grows flower heads so heavy that they lean on the fence and push it into next door's garden.
lore.epic: Turned so blue one summer that the seagulls kept diving into it, thinking it was the sea.
lore.legendary: Changes colour every hour on the hour, so the whole village now sets its clocks by it.

lore.common: Has petals in so many colours that it's named after a rainbow.
lore.uncommon: Has long leaves shaped like swords.
lore.rare: Watches everyone through its eye-shaped petals, so the frogs refuse to croak while it is looking.
lore.epic: Grew so thick round the pond that the ducks had to apply for a gate.
lore.legendary: Stared at a rain cloud until it turned into a rainbow, and now the rainbow follows it round the garden.

lore.common: Climbs up the wall and into the gutters.
lore.uncommon: Hugs the house so tightly that the windows disappear.
lore.rare: Grows into the shape of a face on the wall and pulls faces at the neighbours.
lore.epic: Grew over the whole house in one summer, and the postman couldn't find the letterbox.
lore.legendary: Held up a crumbling castle for so long that the stones retired. The ivy is now the castle.

lore.common: Has leaves so plump that they look like little green coins.
lore.uncommon: Is given as a lucky present at every housewarming.
lore.rare: Grows a coin-shaped leaf every time someone finds money down the sofa, and keeps the coin.
lore.epic: Grew so many babies from fallen leaves that the windowsill became a tiny forest.
lore.legendary: Grew so many coin-shaped leaves that the corner shop's till started taking them instead of money.

lore.common: Smells strongest at night, just as everyone has gone to bed.
lore.uncommon: Twines round the trellis so tightly that nobody can untangle it.
lore.rare: Sends its scent through the keyhole at night, so everyone dreams about holidays and wakes up grumpy.
lore.epic: Smelled so sweet one summer night that every moth in the county came, and the street lights disappeared under them.
lore.legendary: Climbed the town clock and wound itself round the hands, so the whole town is now always on time for tea.

lore.common: Is covered in bees from morning till night.
lore.uncommon: Is tucked into pillows to help people sleep.
lore.rare: Calms anyone who sniffs it, even the angriest dog on the street, who rolls over to have its tummy tickled.
lore.epic: Was hung up to dry in the barn, and the smell knocked the farm cat out until Thursday.
lore.legendary: Made a thunderstorm so relaxed that it forgot to rain and lay down on the hills for a nap.

lore.common: Sticks to the bottom of your shoe and gets walked all the way into the house.
lore.uncommon: Crunches under every boot in autumn.
lore.rare: Falls only on freshly swept paths, and it waits for the broom to be put away first.
lore.epic: Blew across the football pitch in one gust and covered the goal so well that nobody could score all afternoon.
lore.legendary: Held on to its branch so stubbornly that autumn gave up and skipped straight to spring.

lore.common: Paints rocks and walls in yellow and grey splodges.
lore.uncommon: Creeps across a boulder so slowly that it takes a hundred years to cover it.
lore.rare: Grows a little map on every rock, and the hikers keep following it the wrong way.
lore.epic: Covered the town statue so completely that the town forgot who it was and renamed it Mister Yellow.
lore.legendary: Took a thousand years to cover one boulder, then rolled it down the hill to start on a fresh one.

lore.common: Stains everything orange with its pollen.
lore.uncommon: Has a bloom so big that it fills the whole vase.
lore.rare: Opens with a pop so loud at night that the whole house thinks someone is at the door.
lore.epic: Dropped so much pollen in the new living room that the white sofa is now orange, and so is the dog.
lore.legendary: Smelled so strong that the perfume shop in town closed down, saying it could not compete.

lore.common: Grows up out of the muddiest pond.
lore.uncommon: Has leaves so waterproof that raindrops roll off like marbles.
lore.rare: Stays spotless in any mud, so the frogs use it to wipe their feet before going home.
lore.epic: Opened so many flowers at once that the pond rose and the goldfish had to move up a floor.
lore.legendary: Bloomed out of a muddy puddle in the car park and stayed so clean that the car wash asked for its secret.

lore.common: Drops its petals all over the lawn like a carpet.
lore.uncommon: Blooms so early that the frost sometimes catches it.
lore.rare: Blooms before it has any leaves, so it spends every spring explaining to the neighbours that it is not cold.
lore.epic: Dropped so many petals on the school field that sports day was run on a pink carpet, very slowly.
lore.legendary: Dropped a single petal so big that the family used it as a sledge for the rest of the spring.

lore.common: Drops spinning seeds that helicopter down onto everyone's head.
lore.uncommon: Turns bright red in autumn before every other tree.
lore.rare: Sticks to anything sweet, so every autumn pancake arrives with a leaf on top.
lore.epic: Turned so red that the bull in the next field charged the tree all afternoon.
lore.legendary: Turned so red one autumn that the fire brigade came to check.

lore.common: Is so bright orange that it glows in the flowerbed.
lore.uncommon: Shoos away bugs from the vegetables just by being there.
lore.rare: Glows so orange that the snails think it is sunset and go to bed early.
lore.epic: Smelled so strong that every slug packed up and moved next door in one long silver line.
lore.legendary: Glowed so orange in a power cut that the whole street read its bedtime stories by it.

lore.common: Beeps excitedly and finds a bottle cap every time.
lore.uncommon: Beeps so often on the beach that its owner digs a hundred holes.
lore.rare: Beeps at every buckle and zip on the beach, so sunbathers keep getting politely dug round.
lore.epic: Beeped so loudly under the pier that the lifeguards dug the whole beach up. It was a ring pull.
lore.legendary: Found a whole sunken ship under the beach, then lost interest because there were no bottle caps on it.

lore.common: Has a braided trunk that looks like it's been plaited.
lore.uncommon: Is given as a lucky present to every new shop.
lore.rare: Grows a new leaf every time someone says money does not grow on trees, just to prove a point.
lore.epic: Rustled so hopefully in the bank window that a queue formed outside, waiting for it to drop something.
lore.legendary: Finally grew one coin on its top branch. It was a chocolate one, and the tree has never been prouder.

lore.common: Has holes in its leaves that look like they've been nibbled.
lore.uncommon: Takes up half the living room with its giant leaves.
lore.rare: Sends out aerial roots that grab onto the curtains.
lore.epic: Grew a leaf so big that the family used it as a tablecloth for Sunday lunch, and it kept the leftovers.
lore.legendary: Took over a whole flat until the owners moved into the bedroom and gave it the lounge.

lore.common: Squishes underfoot like a damp sponge.
lore.uncommon: Spreads across every shady path until it's slippery.
lore.rare: Turns hard stones into soft green cushions.
lore.epic: Covered the whole garden path in one wet winter, and everyone slipped on it.
lore.legendary: Grew so soft on the town hall steps that the council took the benches away. Nobody has stood up since.

lore.common: Splashes the person in the front of the boat with every stroke.
lore.uncommon: Makes the boat go round in circles when only one is used.
lore.rare: Rows backwards whenever the rower faces forwards, so every trip on the lake starts with an argument.
lore.epic: Splashed so hard in one stroke that it emptied half the boating lake into the cafe.
lore.legendary: Rowed so hard that it pulled the island closer to the shore. The ferry now takes two minutes.

lore.common: Drops all its flowers the moment it's moved to a new windowsill.
lore.uncommon: Has silvery roots that climb out of the pot.
lore.rare: Blooms again just when everyone has given up on it.
lore.epic: Sent its silvery roots across the windowsill and drank the goldfish bowl dry. The goldfish now lives in the teapot.
lore.legendary: Was so fussy that it trained its owners to move house whenever it wanted a better windowsill.

lore.common: Drips water down its handle onto its paddler's lap.
lore.uncommon: Switches from side to side so fast that it splashes everyone.
lore.rare: Paddles towards every waterfall it hears, so the kayak club keep a rope tied to its handle.
lore.epic: Paddled so fast that the kayak went up the waterfall instead of down it.
lore.legendary: Paddled so fast that the kayak beat the speedboat, the ferry and the weather forecast to the island.

lore.common: Has a little face on every flower that seems to be watching you.
lore.uncommon: Survives the frost when every other flower gives up.
lore.rare: Pulls such cheeky faces that the gnome in the next pot has turned round to face the wall.
lore.epic: Grinned out of every window box on the high street until the grumpiest shopkeeper started giving out free sweets.
lore.legendary: Survived a winter so cold that the snowman came to it for advice. It told him to wear a scarf.

lore.common: Snaps its elastic under your chin at the worst moment.
lore.uncommon: Is so pointy that it pokes the person next to you.
lore.rare: Makes whoever wears it the birthday person, so every guest gets sung to and the real birthday boy sulks.
lore.epic: Pinged its elastic so hard that it fired itself through the cake and into the trifle.
lore.legendary: Turned up at every birthday party in town on the same day, uninvited, and still got the first slice each time.

lore.common: Droops dramatically the moment it needs water, as if it's fainting.
lore.uncommon: Has white flowers that look like little sails.
lore.rare: Raises one white flower like a flag whenever an argument starts, and everyone has to stop and say sorry.
lore.epic: Drooped so dramatically during the office inspection that the inspector watered it and forgot to inspect anything.
lore.legendary: Ended a very old argument between two villages by waving one white flower at exactly the right moment.

lore.common: Is covered in ants every spring, which nobody understands.
lore.uncommon: Has a bloom so heavy that it falls over in the rain.
lore.rare: Opens from a tight little ball to a flower the size of a dinner plate overnight.
lore.epic: Opened with such a whoosh in June that it blew the ants off, and they landed in the neighbour's jam.
lore.legendary: Opened a flower so big that the school held its assembly under it on a rainy day.

lore.common: Has sticky petals that cling to your fingers.
lore.uncommon: Spills out of every hanging basket in the street.
lore.rare: Creeps out of its basket along the shop sign, so the bakery now spells BAKERY in petals.
lore.epic: Overflowed its basket so much that the lamp post holding it is now officially a hedge.
lore.legendary: Trailed from a top-floor window box all the way down to the river, and the boats now tie up to it.

lore.common: Opens when it's dry and closes when it's about to rain.
lore.uncommon: Gets chewed by squirrels down to a little core.
lore.rare: Drops on whoever says it is a lovely day for a walk. It never misses.
lore.epic: Fell on the tent in the night so loudly that the whole campsite thought a bear had arrived.
lore.legendary: Opened so wide one dry summer that it dropped a seed which had grown into a whole forest by autumn.

lore.common: Has petals so crinkly that they look like tissue paper.
lore.uncommon: Pops up in fields where nobody planted it.
lore.rare: Pops up in any freshly dug patch, so the builders keep finding red flowers in the new driveway.
lore.epic: Shook its pepper-pot pod so hard over the picnic that every sandwich came out seasoned.
lore.legendary: Scattered one pod of seeds along the railway line, and the train drivers keep stopping to take photos.

lore.common: Trails down from the shelf and tangles round the lamp.
lore.uncommon: Climbs up any shelf, curtain or bookcase it can reach.
lore.rare: Grows towards the wifi router and wraps itself round it, so the internet only works for plants.
lore.epic: Trailed round every shelf in the office until the books were wrapped in leaves.
lore.legendary: Trailed out of the window, down the street and into the library, where it now has its own reading card.

lore.common: Rustles so loudly by the pond that the fishermen think someone is sneaking up behind them.
lore.uncommon: Grows in a thick fence all round the edge of the pond.
lore.rare: Whistles when the wind blows across it, and the ducks line up thinking it is feeding time.
lore.epic: Grew so thick round the lake that the fishing club cut a door in it, and the swans lock it at night.
lore.legendary: Whistled such a catchy tune in the wind that the frogs formed a band and went on tour.

lore.common: Has leaves so shiny that they look polished.
lore.uncommon: Needs its leaves wiped every week, or they get dusty.
lore.rare: Bounces anything that lands on it back where it came from, including the cat.
lore.epic: Grew one leaf so shiny that the sunrise bounced off it and woke the whole street at dawn.
lore.legendary: Stretched so tall one spring that it pushed the roof up and gave the family a free attic.

lore.common: Pops open when touched and sprays seeds at your face.
lore.uncommon: Hitches a ride on the dog's fur and gets planted three streets away.
lore.rare: Rattles like a maraca in the wind, and the garden has a little dance every breezy evening.
lore.epic: Popped so hard in the heat that it fired seeds through the greenhouse glass like tiny marbles.
lore.legendary: Burst with such a bang that seeds landed on every roof in town. The town now has green roofs.

lore.common: Loses its little basket in the deep snow.
lore.uncommon: Pushes its skier along the flat bits when the slope runs out.
lore.rare: Points at whatever its skier is looking at, so they keep skiing straight towards the cafe.
lore.epic: Pushed off so hard on the flat bit that its skier shot past the finish, the car park and the bus stop.
lore.legendary: Pushed its skier so hard that they went up the next mountain and down the other side, winning two races at once.

lore.common: Stands so upright that it looks like it's on guard duty.
lore.uncommon: Survives being forgotten for months.
lore.rare: Stands so still and upright in the hall that burglars think it is a guard and tiptoe away.
lore.epic: Survived a whole term in a student flat on nothing but cold tea, and is now the healthiest thing in it.
lore.legendary: Was forgotten in a cupboard for a whole year and came out taller. It now gives the other plants advice.

lore.common: Sends out baby plants on long stems that dangle everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Hangs from the basket with its babies swinging below.
lore.rare: Lowers its babies on long stems like spiders on threads, and the guests scream every time.
lore.epic: Dangled so many babies from the top shelf that the stairs became a curtain, and the cat moved in with the neighbours.
lore.legendary: Lowered one baby out of a high window so far that it took root in the pavement and grew into a tree.

lore.common: Catches the ball on its top and lets it drop over, which annoys everyone.
lore.uncommon: Sags in the middle so the ball always clips it.
lore.rare: Hums when a ball is about to hit it, so everyone ducks and the ball sails over.
lore.epic: Caught a serve so hard that it fired the ball back over the stands and into the strawberries.
lore.legendary: Stretched so long one summer that a match was played across two towns, and the ball needed a passport.

lore.common: Is always missing exactly one peg.
lore.uncommon: Has a zip that sticks just when you need the toilet in the night.
lore.rare: Drips rain on whoever sleeps nearest the wall.
lore.epic: Was pitched in a field with a thousand others, and nobody could find their own.
lore.legendary: Zipped itself shut so tightly in a storm that it floated down the river with its campers inside, still dry.

lore.common: Pricks your legs when you walk through the meadow in shorts.
lore.uncommon: Puffs out fluffy seeds that float away like little parachutes.
lore.rare: Catches on socks and comes home with you.
lore.epic: Puffed so much fluff into the school playground that the children had a snowball fight in July.
lore.legendary: Guarded its field so fiercely that a whole herd of cows turned round and went to eat someone else's grass.

lore.common: Snaps shut on anything that touches it, including your finger.
lore.uncommon: Waits so still for a fly that it looks fake.
lore.rare: Snaps at anything that buzzes, including the doorbell, the phone and the hairdryer.
lore.epic: Snapped up every fly at the barbecue, then waited by the table for the ketchup.
lore.legendary: Snapped shut on a passing toy drone and kept it as a pet. It flies it round the windowsill every morning.

lore.common: Wraps itself round the fence and won't let go.
lore.uncommon: Grabs everything with its little curly tendrils.
lore.rare: Wraps its tendrils round anything left on the patio overnight, so the bicycle now belongs to the vine.
lore.epic: Wound itself through the garden furniture so tightly that the family ate dinner on the lawn for a month.
lore.legendary: Climbed the new house so fast that it reached the roof before the builders, and now holds the tiles on.

lore.common: Hides under leaves so well that only bees can find it.
lore.uncommon: Has little purple flowers that face the ground.
lore.rare: Hides its scent the moment you sniff it, then lets it out again as soon as you walk away.
lore.epic: Spread so thickly over the woodland path that the walkers had to hop home between them like stepping stones.
lore.legendary: Hid so well that a whole search party went out to find it and came back with two lost dogs and a missing bicycle.

lore.common: Sags in the sand so it's lower at one end.
lore.uncommon: Blocks every spike with a satisfying twang.
lore.rare: Walks up the beach with the tide, so every match starts in a different place.
lore.epic: Hosted a beach rally so long that the tide came in and went out again.
lore.legendary: Blocked a spike so hard that the ball went out to sea, and a fishing boat sent it back a week later.

lore.common: Has a knobbly top that fits only one hand perfectly.
lore.uncommon: Points out every interesting thing on the walk, so a ten-minute stroll takes all afternoon.
lore.rare: Taps so steadily that its walker's feet copy it, and they keep marching even after the walk is over.
lore.epic: Found a short cut that took the whole rambling club through a farmyard, a bakery and somebody's kitchen.
lore.legendary: Was stuck in the ground for a rest and grew into a whole tree. Its owner now walks with the tree's grandchild.

lore.common: Floats its pads so flat that the frogs think they're stepping stones.
lore.uncommon: Is the favourite seat of every frog in the pond.
lore.rare: Closes its flower round any frog that falls asleep inside, then lets it out at lunchtime with a little pop.
lore.epic: Covered the whole village pond so thickly that the ducks walked across it.
lore.legendary: Grew a pad so big that the village held its summer fete on it. Only the tombola sank.

lore.common: Blooms on roadsides where nobody planted it.
lore.uncommon: Throws a party for every bee and butterfly nearby.
lore.rare: Seeds itself in every crack in the road, so the grey car park is now covered in polka dots.
lore.epic: Took over the roundabout so thoroughly that drivers now go round it twice just to look.
lore.legendary: Grew a meadow on the roof of the number nine bus, and the bus now has its own bees.

lore.common: Swings round to face the wrong way every time the door opens, so visitors keep knocking on the wall.
lore.uncommon: Sheds pine needles all over the doormat.
lore.rare: Pricks the knuckles of every visitor who knocks, so everyone has started using the bell.
lore.epic: Rolled off the front door in a gale and bowled down the high street like a hoop, collecting hats.
lore.legendary: Was so welcoming that it invited a passing parade inside, and the band is still in the living room.
